title: Order-of-arrival points engine
description: Implement the locked algorithm: S = players who self-report an arrival rank for a session, N=|S|. Confirmation pts: among S sort by confirmation rank, k-th gets (N-k+1)*100, no-shows drop out & shift up; confirmation denominator excludes arrived-but-never-confirmed (their conf pts=0). Arrival pts: sort S by arrival rank, same formula. Ranks order-only, not literal multiplier. Ties = standard SKIP (500,500,300). Provisional until session Finalized.

V1 build decisions (2026-06-06, post-mockup-approval): App name = KMMGAFDRA (KFANDRA's Monthly Multi-Game And Fitness Data Recording App), internal only. NO COACH APPROVAL ANYWHERE — players self-submit and self-serve; submissions are recorded directly. Point values seed = MMG Rules.md (authoritative), admin-editable later. Order of confirmation AND order of arrival: each player submits BOTH his own ranks, points computed from order (N x100 descending), no approval. Sessions pre-defined: every Tue/Thu/Sat of the month; players submit per-session performance, no coach dependency. Auth: anyone can register phone+PIN, no external registrations expected, no approval gate. Google Sheet: fixed sheet provided, ID configurable by admins (Jaidev/Coach) later. Edit window (8am practice -> noon submit) = NO enforcement, just a nudge; depends on player submission. Gym logging is NOT point-bearing — tracks performance only. Deploy pipeline (CI/CD + wire Vercel to GitHub) is IN scope for V1.

Vercel deploy is NOT wired to GitHub for kfandra-track. Pushing to main does NOT auto-deploy. JACARANDA order-points + submit-flow rules (locked 2026-06-07). ORDER POINTS: S = players who self-report an ARRIVAL rank for the session (= those who showed); N=|S|. Confirmation points: among S, sort by self-reported confirmation rank; k-th gets (N-k+1)*100; no-shows drop out, everyone below shifts up. Arrival points: sort S by arrival rank; k-th gets (N-k+1)*100. Ranks used only to ORDER, not as literal multiplier. TIES = standard SKIP ranking (500,500,300). Arrived-but-never-confirmed: gets 0 confirmation pts and is NOT counted in the confirmation denominator (confirmation N = confirmed-and-arrived count, may be < arrival N). Order is self-reported (trust-based, no approval). SUBMIT FLOW = HYBRID: local autosave drafts (offline-safe, Option A); a lightweight 'Finalize/Done' action per MMG/Gym session (NOT an approval gate) that flushes to server, signals order-N computation, and is the nudge target. Diet = pure continuous current-day autosave, no finalize (not scored). N for order points provisional until session finalized.
